name: place_id
label: Place ID
help: Google place ID (ChIJ…) from Search Google Maps places. Or fill in CID or FID instead.

name: cid
label: CID
help: Decimal customer ID from a Maps result, instead of Place ID.

name: fid
label: FID
help: Feature ID (0x…:0x…) from a Maps result, instead of Place ID.

name: country
label: Country
help: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), such as us, gb or de. The API uses us when this is empty.

name: language
label: Language
help: Interface language code, such as en, de or pt-br. The API uses en when this is empty.
